title: Plegma II: Ask Me Any Cell (Hard Version)
statement: The task is to encode each cell of an n×n grid as a 0/1 grid with only 3 zeros, the optimum, plus one table mapping S (ones in a memoryless robot's current rectangle) to a side to trim. Fixing the shape sequence gives each step its own S band, so zeros form a hidden counter whose drop times set the top and left cuts before a searched 4×4 endgame.
